Surface: infra

## Current State

`design-wrapper` currently routes design-quality work to Impeccable only. A described set of five Claude Code design plugins includes a Taste skill (anti-slop styling, 76k GitHub stars) and a Web Design Guidelines skill (audits against Vercel's rules including accessibility).

## Deliverables

- Trial the Taste and Web Design Guidelines skills against a sample build alongside Impeccable's own passes.
- Decide whether either complements or duplicates Impeccable's finish-reviewer/asset-producer roles.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A short comparison note on overlap/gaps versus Impeccable, checked into `design-wrapper`'s docs.

## Release Note

No user-visible change: evaluated the Taste and Web Design Guidelines skills for design reviews.

## Technical Approach

Run Taste and Web Design Guidelines against the same sample build `design-wrapper`'s Impeccable passes (`impeccable-finish-reviewer`, `impeccable-asset-producer`) already cover, and compare findings directly: does either surface issues Impeccable misses (e.g. Web Design Guidelines' accessibility rules against Vercel's own bar), or does either largely duplicate Impeccable's existing critique? Write the comparison as a short note, landing in `design-wrapper`'s docs alongside its existing mode documentation.

### Key Files

- `plugin/skills/design-wrapper/modes/` — the existing Impeccable-routed passes to compare against
- `plugin/skills/design-wrapper/` docs — where the comparison note lands

## Gotchas

- Both third-party skills are external plugins this repo doesn't own — availability/version drift should be noted in the comparison if either isn't stably installable.
- This is a comparison-and-decide record — a "duplicates Impeccable, no action" outcome is a valid, complete result, not a failure to find value.

## Original request

Evaluate Taste/Web-Design-Guidelines skills for design-wrapper

Current State:
- design-wrapper currently routes design-quality work to Impeccable only.
- A reel names five Claude Code design plugins: a Taste skill (anti-slop styling, 76k GitHub stars), a Web Design Guidelines skill (audits against Vercel's rules incl. accessibility), a full design-system skill, 21st Dev MCP (10k+ UI components), and Playwright CLI for self-screenshot review.

Deliverables:
- Trial the Taste and Web Design Guidelines skills against a sample build alongside Impeccable's own passes.
- Decide whether either complements or duplicates Impeccable's finish-reviewer/asset-producer roles.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A short comparison note on overlap/gaps versus Impeccable, checked into design-wrapper's docs.

Source: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcEFABnvBuH/

Surface: backend

## Current State

Record #649 added `_shared/subagent-output-contract.md`'s fan-out single-assistant-message-rule
sentence and per-site citations (AC1, fully test-pinned in `tests/subagent-contract-clauses.test.js`,
18/18 passing). AC2 — "A `/specify` red-team over 2+ `ceremony:standard` sub-issues launches its
personas in ≤ (number of sub-issues) assistant messages, verified in the transcript by `Agent`
tool_use blocks sharing a message id" — is a live-behavior criterion that cannot be verified by a
static `node --test` assertion; it can only be confirmed by observing an actual future `/specify`
decomposition run's transcript.

## Deliverables

Confirm, at the next `/specify` decomposition run over 2+ `ceremony:standard` sub-issues, that
persona dispatch actually batches into ≤N assistant messages per `_shared/subagent-output-contract.md`'s
fan-out single-assistant-message rule and `red-team.md`'s per-sub-issue batching unit. Record the
observation (transcript excerpt or note) against this item, or file a defect against
`red-team.md`'s dispatch prose if it does not.

## Acceptance Criteria

A `/specify` run over 2+ `ceremony:standard` sub-issues is observed; its persona `Agent` tool_use
calls are confirmed (via transcript `tool_use` block message-id grouping) to arrive in ≤ (number of
sub-issues) assistant messages.

## Release Note

No user-visible change: verified that spec red-team reviews batch correctly across several sub-issues.

## Technical Approach

Wait for (or trigger) a `/claude-tweaks:specify` decomposition-mode run that produces 2 or more
`ceremony:standard` sub-issue records — `ceremony-check` (`assess-agent-autonomy/ceremony-check.md`)
resolves the tier per sub-issue during that run's own Step 3, so the tier isn't knowable until the
run happens. Once such a run occurs, inspect that session's stored transcript for the Step 5
red-team dispatch (`specify/red-team.md`'s Parallel dispatch section): locate the `Agent` tool_use
blocks for each dispatched persona and group them by the assistant message id each block belongs
to. Confirm the number of distinct assistant message ids covering all persona dispatches for a
given sub-issue is ≤ the number of sub-issues in that batch. Use the same read-only transcript
inspection method `transcript-payload-verification` documents for reading this session's own
locally-stored transcript, rather than instrumenting or modifying `red-team.md` itself.

If the count exceeds the bound, file a defect issue against `red-team.md`'s dispatch prose
(quoting the transcript grouping that violates the rule) instead of editing the file directly from
this record — this record's own deliverable is the observation, not the fix.

### Key Files

- `plugin/skills/specify/red-team.md` — the per-sub-issue persona dispatch procedure being observed
- `plugin/skills/_shared/subagent-output-contract.md` — the fan-out single-assistant-message rule this observation verifies compliance with
- `tests/subagent-contract-clauses.test.js` — AC1's existing static test coverage (unaffected by this record)

## Gotchas

- This record's acceptance criterion depends on an external event (a live `/specify` decomposition
  run over 2+ `ceremony:standard` sub-issues happening) that this record cannot itself trigger on a
  fixed schedule — it may sit open for some time until a qualifying run occurs naturally, or until
  someone deliberately runs one to close it out.
- A qualifying run must be observed via its own transcript at the time it happens; this record
  cannot be resolved from historical data if no already-completed run's transcript is still
  available.

## Original request

Verify /specify red-team fan-out batching at next live multi-sub-issue run (#649 AC2)
